name: @pandafile/mcp

tools.name: send_files
tools.description: Upload local files and/or folders to Pandafile and get a share link (https://pandafile.co/d/<id>). Folders are sent with their structure. Large files are fine (resumable, chunked uploads); the call returns when the upload is complete. If recipients are given, each gets an email with a personal download link. Returns the link, id, expiry and sizes. Only send files the user asked you to send.

paths.description: Absolute paths of files or folders on this computer (~ is expanded), e.g. ["/Users/ada/Desktop/final-cut.mov", "/Users/ada/Desktop/stills"].

title.description: Title shown on the download page and in emails (up to 120 characters).

message.description: Message to the recipients (up to 1000 characters).

recipients.description: Email addresses to send the link to. Leave out to just get a link.

expires_in_days.description: Keep the files this many days from now (1–90). Pro/Team only, at most 90 days after sending; not for test keys. Leave out for the plan default.

expires_at.description: Exact expiry as ISO 8601 (e.g. "2026-12-31T23:00:00Z"). Alternative to expires_in_days; same limits.

password.description: Download password (8–200 characters). Recipients need it to download. Plus/Pro/Team only.

tools.name: send_from_urls
tools.description: Create a Pandafile transfer from files at public https URLs: Pandafile downloads them itself (no local upload). Waits up to ~20 seconds. status "ready": the link works now. status "uploading": big files are still downloading – call get_import_status with the id until it is "ready" (or "failed"). Recipients are emailed when it is ready.

url.description: Public https URL of the file (at most 3 redirects).

name.description: File name to use (default: from the server or the URL).

message.description: Message to the recipients (up to 1000 characters).

recipients.description: Email addresses to send the link to once the transfer is ready.

expires_in_days.description: Keep the files this many days from now (1–90). Pro/Team only, at most 90 days after sending; not for test keys. Leave out for the plan default.

expires_at.description: Exact expiry as ISO 8601 (e.g. "2026-12-31T23:00:00Z"). Alternative to expires_in_days; same limits.

password.description: Download password (8–200 characters). Recipients need it to download. Plus/Pro/Team only.

tools.name: get_import_status
tools.description: Progress of a transfer created with send_from_urls: per file bytes received, then "ready" (the link works) or "failed" (with the error; the transfer is then deleted).

id.description: Transfer id: the last part of the share link (https://pandafile.co/d/<id>), e.g. "k3x9q2m7ab".

tools.name: list_transfers
tools.description: The account's transfers, newest first, with link, size, expiry and download counts. view "active" (default: live and still uploading) or "history" (expired, deleted, blocked). Pass next_cursor as cursor for the next page.

query.description: Search title, id, recipient email or file name.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous call, for the next page.

tools.name: get_transfer
tools.description: One transfer in detail: link, status, expiry (and the latest expiry possible), files, recipients (who was emailed, who downloaded), latest downloads, approvals/comments from recipients and link statistics (views, downloads, countries).

id.description: Transfer id: the last part of the share link (https://pandafile.co/d/<id>), e.g. "k3x9q2m7ab".

tools.name: add_recipients
tools.description: Email the transfer's link to more people: each new address gets an email with a personal download link. Addresses already on the transfer are skipped.

id.description: Transfer id: the last part of the share link (https://pandafile.co/d/<id>), e.g. "k3x9q2m7ab".

tools.name: remind_recipient
tools.description: Email a recipient of the transfer their personal link again (and turn their reminders back on). At most twice an hour per recipient.

id.description: Transfer id: the last part of the share link (https://pandafile.co/d/<id>), e.g. "k3x9q2m7ab".

tools.name: update_transfer
tools.description: Change a live transfer: title, message, expiry (later only, Pro/Team, at most 90 days after it was sent – get_transfer shows latest_possible_expiry) and the download password (set a new one, or remove it with remove_password). Only the fields you give change.

id.description: Transfer id: the last part of the share link (https://pandafile.co/d/<id>), e.g. "k3x9q2m7ab".

expires_in_days.description: Keep the files this many days from now (1–90). Pro/Team only, at most 90 days after sending; not for test keys. Leave out for the plan default.

expires_at.description: Exact expiry as ISO 8601 (e.g. "2026-12-31T23:00:00Z"). Alternative to expires_in_days; same limits.

password.description: Download password (8–200 characters). Recipients need it to download. Plus/Pro/Team only.

tools.name: delete_transfer
tools.description: Delete a transfer now: its files are removed for good and the link stops working for everyone. This cannot be undone – confirm with the user first.

id.description: Transfer id: the last part of the share link (https://pandafile.co/d/<id>), e.g. "k3x9q2m7ab".

tools.name: create_file_request
tools.description: Create a file request: an upload page (link) anyone can use to send files to this account – e.g. to collect photos or documents from a client. Uploads show up as transfers. Needs a live key on Pro/Team.

title.description: What you are asking for, shown on the upload page (up to 120 characters).

message.description: Instructions shown on the upload page (up to 1000 characters).

tools.name: list_file_requests
tools.description: The account's file requests (upload pages) with their links, whether they are open and how many uploads came in. Pass next_cursor as cursor for the next page.

tools.name: close_file_request
tools.description: Stop a file request from accepting uploads (its upload page then says it is closed). Files already uploaded stay. It can be reopened from the dashboard.

id.description: File request id (from create_file_request or list_file_requests).

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: The account behind the API key: plan, limits (max bytes per transfer, expiry days, features), usage (this week / month, storage) and whether the key is a test key.

instructions:
Pandafile (https://pandafile.co) sends big files with a link. Use these tools to:
- send local files or whole folders (send_files) or files at https URLs (send_from_urls) and get a share link,
- look up, change, delete transfers and add or remind recipients,
- collect files from other people with file requests (an upload page),
- check the account's plan, limits and usage (get_account).
Recipients get an email with their own link (never with a test key: pf_test_ keys make test transfers that email nobody and expire after 24 hours).
Share links look like https://pandafile.co/d/<id>. Files are stored in Helsinki, Finland (EU).
